remarks: Charming, sun-drenched bungalow bursting with character and timeless appeal! Gorgeous hardwood floors, exquisite natural woodwork, crown molding throughout, and beautiful leaded-glass windows showcase the home's classic craftsmanship. Freshly painted interior, all-new windows, and updated mechanics add modern comfort. The inviting open living room features a cozy gas fireplace, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Four generous bedrooms, including a primary bedroom with walk-in closet, plus a first-floor full bath with classic subway tile and cast-iron tub. The spacious granite and stainless-steel kitchen features a charming breakfast nook. A versatile bonus room, currently used as a laundry room, offers potential for a fifth bedroom. Upstairs, enjoy a beautifully refinished second floor with a creative workstation, oversized guest bedroom, and completely renovated full bath. Super-dry basement and detached two-car garage round out this exceptional home. Classic charm, thoughtful updates, and room to spread out—this bungalow is a must-see!
